title: Architecture of Orientation Research Programme
purpose: Develop and test a general account of how agents acquire, inhabit, defend, revise and evaluate worlds of meaningful action while preserving distinctions among coherence, empirical warrant, moral warrant and metaphysical interpretation.
notPurpose: To prove Jordan Peterson correct as a total system
To infer moral or metaphysical truth from mythic recurrence
To treat graph consistency as empirical confirmation
To automate corpus admission or replace human judgement

sourcery.purpose: Decomposition, bounded derivation searches, assumption/loss ledgers, rejection receipts and immutable work snapshots.

claimipedia.purpose: Durable claim, evidence, challenge, review, evaluation, metric and third-order-audit memory.

lanes.title: Mechanisms of disclosure
lanes.primaryQuestion: How is an actionable world disclosed and maintained?

lanes.title: Identity and transformation
lanes.primaryQuestion: Why do anomalies sometimes revise and sometimes destabilize an agent?

lanes.title: Culture and institutions
lanes.primaryQuestion: How are orientations socially scaffolded and governed?

lanes.title: Correction and pathology
lanes.primaryQuestion: How do persons and systems learn, resist learning or become captured?

lanes.title: Myth and symbolic inheritance
lanes.primaryQuestion: What orientation-relevant structures recur in cultural narratives?

lanes.title: Normative evaluation
lanes.primaryQuestion: What makes an orientation better, more truthful or more just?

lanes.title: Metaphysical interpretation
lanes.primaryQuestion: What larger account, if any, best explains the landscape?

workPackages.title: Programme constitution and authority boundary
completionCriteria: proposal-only authority is machine-readable
every later work package inherits the constitution

workPackages.title: Initial-tranche adversarial review
outputs: at least one attempted split, downgrade or retirement
completionCriteria: all eight claims receive internal, rival-framework, affected-party and reflexive review
each claim has a human disposition
the programme demonstrates that criticism can subtract

workPackages.title: Embodiment, tacit knowledge and relational orientation
completionCriteria: at least one discriminating consequence beyond redescription
tacit evidence is represented without being claimed as exhausted

workPackages.title: Attention, affordance and identity-central anomaly
completionCriteria: attention is separated from expectation, report and motor preparation
identity centrality is tested beyond incentives and coalition pressure

workPackages.title: Culture, norms, power and institutional legibility
completionCriteria: culture is modelled as causal scaffolding rather than background decoration
individual and institutional explanations remain distinct

workPackages.title: Correction-cycle and capture dynamics
completionCriteria: optimal corrigibility is distinguished from maximal openness
failure locations can be empirically classified
material and power explanations are included

workPackages.title: Mythic transformation invariants
completionCriteria: coding reliability is demonstrated blind to the target hypothesis
proposed invariants outperform generic narrative controls
failed invariants are retired

workPackages.title: Meaning, warrant and moral frame transformations
completionCriteria: meaning-is-not-warrant is not inflated into meaning-is-not-evidence
frame choices are justified without simple circularity

workPackages.title: Comparative metaphysical interpretation
completionCriteria: mythic recurrence is not used as proof
at least two serious rivals are represented symmetrically
the Logos interpretation is permitted to lose locally

workPackages.title: Applied clinical and institutional programmes
completionCriteria: failure claims specify outcome, population, comparator, mechanism and scale
applications outperform or clarify existing alternatives

workPackages.title: Programme synthesis and recursive audit
completionCriteria: the programme records substantive losses as well as extensions
remaining scope and failure conditions are explicit
version 2 requires fresh human authorization

programmeMetrics.name: claim-packet-completeness
programmeMetrics.definition: Proportion of active claims satisfying the minimum claim packet.

programmeMetrics.name: live-rival-coverage
programmeMetrics.definition: Proportion of active claims with a serious independently stated rival and discriminants.

programmeMetrics.name: subtractive-correction-rate
programmeMetrics.definition: Proportion of completed review cycles that narrow, split, downgrade, supersede or retire at least one claim.

programmeMetrics.name: evidence-coverage
programmeMetrics.definition: Proportion of empirical claims with provenance-bearing supporting and challenging evidence.

programmeMetrics.name: cross-layer-collapse-count
programmeMetrics.definition: Unresolved instances of analogy, recurrence, adaptation, mechanism or meaning being promoted beyond its warranted authority.

programmeMetrics.name: out-of-sample-performance
programmeMetrics.definition: Performance of empirical models on cases not used to construct the architecture.

programmeMetrics.name: affected-party-standing
programmeMetrics.definition: Proportion of normative and institutional claims reviewed from the perspective of those bearing their costs.

programmeFailureConditions: No claim is ever retired or materially narrowed.
Every anomaly is redescribed as confirmation of a larger architecture.
Metaphors carry conclusions that operational claims cannot support.
Empirical failures are rescued through metaphysical expansion.
Participant evidence is either romanticized or excluded by default.
The programme's classifications systematically protect programme insiders.
Orientation becomes an unrestricted synonym for psychological or social causation.
